mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) level below 3.5% signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in payrolls (PAYEMS) signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, a housing starts (HOUST) decline below 1400 thousand units signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST falls below 1400 during late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE) level below 4.0% signals strong labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 (index 2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls below 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and drop in real sales (RSAFS) below 700,000 million dollars signals weakening consumer demand, generating negative 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST declines and RSAFS falls below 700,000.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regime, a year-over-year CPIAUCSL increase above 3.5% signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 3.5% during high-inflation regime.
